scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Tiered KV Cache Offloading in vLLM
papers.abstract: Host-centric KV cache tiers support filesystem, object storage and peers. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, 2 H100 GPUs, storage offload more than doubles prefiller throughput beyond 128 conversations.
papers.summary: vLLM 将被逐出的 KV 缓存经主机内存写入文件系统、对象存储或远端节点，后续请求可加载缓存，减少重复预填充。在 2 张 H100、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的多轮对话实验中，会话池超过 128 后，存储卸载的预填充吞吐超过替代方案的两倍；该结果不包含完整解码链路。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的多轮问答和共享背景提示可先统计前缀复用率，再决定是否配置分层缓存。统一主机布局允许不同张量并行配置共享数据，适合扩容与负载迁移；上线应同时跟踪缓存命中率、传输耗时和首字延迟，避免把预填充吞吐收益直接视为端到端收益。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: Following the Bottleneck: Optimizing MiniMax M3 on AMD Instinct MI355X
papers.abstract: At concurrency 32, fixed TP4/EP1 MXFP8 throughput rises from 109.1 to 342.4 output tokens/s/GPU; TTFT 1.46 to 0.67 seconds. Shared-expert fusion, local-shape tuning, paging and correctness auditing.
papers.summary: 团队围绕 MiniMax M3 在 MI355X 上的实际瓶颈，改进局部矩阵形状调优、共享专家融合、稀疏分页及推理正确性。在相同 TP4/EP1、MXFP8 配置和并发 32 下，每卡输出吞吐由 109.1 升至 342.4 token/s，首字延迟中位数由 1.46 降至 0.67 秒。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索的查询改写与大模型排序服务，可借鉴逐层定位、消除重复工作、再检查系统排队的优化顺序。必须固定输入输出长度、精度及并行拓扑比较，并用跟踪记录确认目标内核真正执行；配置打开、输出正确和端到端变快应分别验证，不能只依据配置名称归因。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: How Lossless Is Lossless Speculative Decoding? The Role of Numerical Precision in Orthrus
papers.authors: Ilya Koziev, Leonid Sinev, Ivan Oseledets
papers.abstract:
Orthrus is a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion architecture that accelerates autoregressive language-model inference by generating multiple tokens in parallel while using a frozen autoregressive backbone. Its central claim is that an intra-model consensus mechanism enables lossless speculative decoding, producing the same output sequence as the autoregressive model.
  We independently reproduce Orthrus and examine this claim under different numerical precisions. Under BF16 inference, exact trajectory matching occurs in only 45% of cases for the authors' checkpoint and 43% for our independently trained model across 1,190 prompts from 12 domains. The probability of exact matching is also strongly associated with the response-conditional perplexity of the reference model. Despite this trajectory divergence, Orthrus does not show systematic degradation on downstream lm-eval-harness benchmarks. In contrast, repeating the trajectory evaluation with FP32 yields exact trajectory matching on all
papers.summary: 研究独立复现 Orthrus，检验自回归与扩散混合投机解码的无损声明。在 12 个领域的 1190 条提示上，BF16 下原作者检查点与复现模型的完整输出轨迹一致率仅为 45% 和 43%；FP32 在全部受测提示上一致，但 BF16 的下游任务未出现系统性退化。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若用投机解码加速查询改写、标签生成或排序解释，应把逐 token 一致性和业务指标稳定性分开验收。该结果提示浮点精度会改变轨迹，不能只凭算法证明宣称线上完全等价；建议保存基线输出，分别比较语义质量、nDCG、CTR 与延迟，而非直接升级全部服务到 FP32。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: Self-Indexing Attention for Compression-Compatible Sparse Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.authors: Xu Yang, Jiapeng Zhang,  Zhangke, Changjian Chen, Yuxin Chen, Feiqiang Sun, Chengguang Xu, Feng Jin, Zhuo Tang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.13205v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Sparse long-context inference requires efficient token retrieval in both prefill and decode. Existing methods often use different retrieval strategies for the two stages, preventing one retrieval representation from being reused throughout inference. We propose Self-Indexing Attention, a training-free framework built on a shared transform-domain sign-magnitude representation. The key signs provide a reusable token-level index for grouped prefill selection and decode retrieval, while the same representation remains compatible with external KV-cache compression without separate indexer metadata. This 1-bit index enables efficient retrieval through bitwise operations widely supported by modern accelerators. At 5% attention density, Self-Indexing Attention remains close to dense attention on LongBench and RULER and achieves up to 6.1x prefill and 10.3x decode attention-operator speedups. Experiments with TurboQuant and DeepSeekV4-Flash furth
papers.summary: 论文用变换域符号与幅值表示统一预填充和解码的稀疏注意力检索，以 1 bit 符号索引减少额外元数据，并兼容 KV 压缩。在 5% 注意力密度下，LongBench 和 RULER 表现接近稠密注意力，预填充与解码注意力算子最高分别加速 6.1 倍和 10.3 倍。
papers.key_insight: 对于需要读取多个帖子、评论片段的社区搜索大模型，可评估同一索引跨阶段复用是否减少缓存与检索开销。优先验证短证据是否被稀疏选择遗漏，并在相同上下文长度下联合测试 KV 量化；论文给出的是注意力算子加速，线上整体收益还取决于前馈层和调度占比。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: Dense vs. MoE Models: Active Parameters, Throughput, and When to Choose Each
papers.abstract: How can a 30B-parameter model activate only 3B parameters per token, and still use the capacity of the larger model? Nemotron 3.5 Lightning illustrates the...
papers.summary: 文章解释稠密模型与 MoE 的部署成本差异，并比较参数规模、显存、吞吐及量化约束。Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 总参数约 30B、每 token 激活 3B，BF16 权重仍需约 60GB；文中引用的提供商输出速度为 235.7—494.2 token/s，跨服务商数据不能视为受控对照实验。
papers.key_insight: 为社区搜索选择查询理解模型时，要同时核算总权重显存、KV 容量及每 token 激活计算量。低激活参数并不意味着低显存需求，且路由和数据搬运会随并发改变收益；应在真实短查询和长证据分布上测试精度与吞吐，量化时还需单独保护路由及混合注意力中的敏感模块。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: Cost Characterization of Vertically Partitioned Federated Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Md Saikat Islam Khan Bappy, Oshani Seneviratne
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.13664v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Knowledge graphs are increasingly distributed across autonomous organizations that share an entity space but own disjoint subsets of relations, forming a vertical partition. Answering a multi-hop query may require combining facts from several silos, making the partitioning strategy a key data management decision that affects communication, indexing, load balance, and query latency. However, the costs associated with different partitioning strategies remain insufficiently studied. We formalize vertical partitioning as a design space and compare four strategies: semantic domain grouping, frequency-balanced partitioning, co-occurrence graph-cut partitioning, and random partitioning. We evaluate them using five metrics: communication cost, candidate index size, cross-silo path length, load balance, and end-to-end query latency. Three of the five prove to be determined by the graph and the silo count rather than by the partition, which redu
papers.summary: 研究固定联邦知识图谱问答模型，比较四种关系划分策略及五项成本指标，隔离数据划分的影响。在 PathQuestion、三个数据孤岛设置中，共现图切分使跨孤岛路径率从 0.517 降至 0.276，约减少 47%；局部性收益与负载均衡存在冲突，且更多孤岛会削弱收益。
papers.key_insight: 如果社区搜索需要跨团队或跨数据域组织知识，可先区分结构上的跨域路径和实际在线网络调用，避免把两者混为一谈。本文固定系统在推理时不访问孤岛，因此路径率下降不代表查询延迟同比下降；可借鉴它控制模型不变、单独测量分区策略的评估方法，再结合真实通信协议判断价值。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: How NVIDIA NVLink 6 Delivers Multi-Layer Resiliency for AI Factories
papers.abstract: For operators of large-scale AI factories, maximizing continuous output is essential for productivity. In massive-scale AI training, every GPU in the cluster...
papers.summary: 文章介绍 NVLink 6 从纠错、链路重传和信用流控到软件恢复的分层容错设计，并说明预热影子进程如何避免推理引擎冷启动。在文中 B200 部署测试中，影子引擎把故障停机从 283 秒缩短至 7.3 秒；此数字来自厂商软件部署测试，不是 NVLink 6 全平台性能对照。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若使用多卡大模型，故障恢复时间会直接影响可用容量及尾延迟，应把它纳入服务指标。可借鉴预热进程提前创建独立通信器的方式，同时核算备用资源成本；原文部分多节点检查点能力仍为原型，选型时须分别确认已可用的软件功能和后续硬件路线图。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: Scaling Federated Learning Across Docker, Kubernetes, and Slurm with NVIDIA FLARE
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) projects often begin with a straightforward setup: one server, a few clients, and one dataset at each site. As those projects grow, the...
papers.summary: NVIDIA FLARE 把常驻联邦协调服务与按需启动的训练工作进程分开，让参与方保留本地数据、镜像和调度策略。2.8 版本支持 Docker 与 Kubernetes，2.9 增加 Slurm，资源需求统一描述后由各站点映射到本地执行环境；文章给出三种部署路径，未提供量化吞吐或精度实验。
papers.key_insight: 当社区搜索训练数据分散在多个团队且已有不同集群时，可借鉴协调层常驻、训练工作进程按需申请 GPU 的设计。它能减少统一调度平台的前置改造，也让环境升级和联邦身份管理分开演进；是否节省成本仍需测量排队时间、GPU 空闲占用与任务失败率，不能从架构说明直接推出。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: Token Merging for Multilingual Speech Recognition: A Systematic Study Across Model Scale and Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.13151v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Leading multilingual speech recognition models like Whisper transcribe diverse, low-resource languages without language-specific training but are computationally expensive to deploy. Token merging mitigates this inefficiency by dynamically combining redundant features, shortening the sequence length during inference without requiring retraining. In this paper, we systematically evaluate token merging on the Whisper model family across sixteen diverse languages and three different model sizes. We also test how token merging interacts with fine-tuning (DoRA) on low-resource languages. Our findings show that merging tokens increases computational efficiency with almost no loss in transcription accuracy across most low-resource languages and model sizes, and it works even after the model has been fine-tuned. Our results demonstrate that token merging is a highly practical method for making multilingual speech recognition faster and cheaper t
papers.summary: 论文在 Whisper 编码器中合并相邻且相似的 token，无需重训，并在 16 种语言、三个模型规模上检查与 DoRA 微调的兼容性。RTX 3080 Ti 上，40% token 缩减使编码器加速 1.21 倍；微调后六种训练语言的最大 WER 增幅为 0.59 个百分点，十种留出语言为 0.97。
papers.key_insight: 该方法适合社区语音查询转写或音视频内容入库，和纯文本相关性模型的联系较间接。相邻合并保留时间顺序，适合先在现有转写模型上小范围试验；验收时需要把识别错误对实体词、召回和 nDCG 的影响单独统计，并测完整转写链路，不能把编码器加速直接当成搜索响应加速。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。

papers.title: How NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Deterministic Execution Drives Power-Efficient High-Interactivity Inference on NVIDIA Vera Rubin
papers.abstract: Power is a defining constraint for AI factories. As AI workloads demand a full compute platform to serve them, each component of that platform must maximize...
papers.summary: Groq 3 LPX 利用覆盖 256 个 LPU 的确定性执行计划，提前预测电流变化，并通过预调供电和时钟周期整形降低电压裕量。厂商内部测试报告电压跌落减少超过 60%；同等工作负载功耗降低低两位数百分比仍属潜在估计，不能当成已独立验证的系统能效收益。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索推理容量规划可以借鉴按功率预算和交互延迟共同评估系统的思路，而非只看峰值吞吐。确定性执行对低延迟服务有参考意义，但收益依赖专用硬件与编译栈，短期迁移成本较高；更直接的行动是记录每请求能耗、稳定负载功率及尾延迟，作为后续平台比较基线。
papers.evidence_note: 原文已核验；业务迁移建议为编辑分析。
